title: Smart Note as the universal governed intelligence capture command

source.human_directive: SMART NOTE THIS AND SEND ME THE SMART LINKS SHOWING THE PROOF IT WAS DONE AND INPUT CORRECTLY SO IT WORKS SUCCESSFULLY!

intelligence.essence: Smart Note is the universal human command for turning valuable conversation or experience into durable governed intelligence. The canonical unit remains the Intelligent Block; Smart Note must route through the existing NayaPOWER intelligence river rather than create a new Node family or parallel memory system.

human_view.meaning: Say 'Smart Note this' when something matters enough that Shawn should not have to explain it again.
human_view.why_it_matters: Important intelligence should survive the conversation, remain organized, and be available to future authorized Nayas without turning Shawn into the filing system.
human_view.simple_rule: Understand it, distill it, connect it, preserve it, retrieve it when relevant, learn from verified outcomes.

naya_view.purpose: Make conversational intelligence reusable, provenance-bound, contextually retrievable, and capable of later learning/compounding.
naya_view.architectural_rule: Intelligent Blocks are the durable intelligence units. SELF, LAW, ACT, KNOW, PROVE, CONNECT, VERIFY, LEARN, and EVOLVE process those units; a note does not create another Naya Node.
naya_view.retrieval_rule: All authorized Nayas should share one contextual retrieval interface over the canonical intelligence index; awareness means discoverability when applicable, not loading all intelligence into every prompt.
naya_view.learning_rule: Capture may automatically reach CANDIDATE only. Evidence, application, observed outcomes, and verification determine later promotion.

simple_view.child: Naya keeps the smart part of an important conversation so the next Naya can find it and use it.
simple_view.grandma: If we learn something worth keeping, Naya files the useful meaning in the right place, keeps where it came from, and does not pretend an idea is proven until experience proves it.

decisions: Lock Smart Note as the universal intelligence capture command.
Keep Intelligent Block as the canonical unit; do not create Naya Nodes per note.
Extend the current canonical nayanet-intelligence-commit-runtime envelope to accept rich Smart Note representations.
Preserve raw source separately from distilled intelligence; transcript is not intelligence.
Add duplicate and contradiction reconciliation before blindly creating Blocks.
Have CONNECT infer candidate relationships automatically.
Make every authorized Naya use one contextual retrieval interface against the same intelligence index.
Keep proactive/automatic captures at CANDIDATE maximum; evidence promotes them.
Add Smart Note to application to outcome to learning feedback.
Make capture nearly invisible to Shawn while preserving the explicit command.
intelligence.priority: Unify the rich Smart Note contract with the current canonical intelligence-commit river before adding more Nodes or another Smart Note system.
intelligence.objective: Build and prove Smart Note Capture V2 on the existing nayanet-intelligence-commit-runtime so natural conversation can be distilled into one or more CANDIDATE Intelligent Blocks with multiple views, provenance, applicability and relationships, persisted through Event → Block → Lineage → Relationship → Index → Checkpoint, then cold-retrieved without the original conversation.

applicability.non_goal: Do not create a second brain, duplicate graph, new authority system, or one Naya Node per note.

proof_required: Canonical Event, Intelligent Block, Lineage, Relationship, Index, Checkpoint and Receipt persist.
Independent verifier rereads the persisted objects.
Persisted block content exactly matches the distilled Smart Note payload.
A later cold Naya can retrieve and correctly use the intelligence without receiving the original conversation.
intelligence.uncertainty: The current canonical receiver can persist this rich representation as the lesson payload, but first-class structured rich-view fields and full automatic duplicate/reconciliation/relationship inference are not yet proven as generalized runtime behavior.
